thread:
rafael: FYI I clicked a link from the API quickstart to the runtime docs and the '#batching' fragment jumps to the very top of the page instead of the section.

anya: thanks for reporting. which page exactly? staging or prod?

rafael: staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/runtime/serving.md#batching — reproduces in both Chrome and curl.

morgan: quick check: probably the heading slug changed after a tidy. I hit the same a while back with the 'kv-cache' section.

ivy: can someone own a tiny fix? should be no more than adding an explicit anchor or restoring a frontmatter id.

rafael: I'm happy to open a micro-PR if no objections.

morgan: prefer frontmatter id when possible so external links remain stable even if headings drift. pattern we use: add `id: <slug>` in the top frontmatter.

anya: pinging buildbot to see last edit and whether this file is in recent refactor commits.

buildbot: file modified recently: docs/runtime/serving.md by @morgan on 2025-09-02 (commit c12d4a).

morgan: yep that was me — I renamed "Batching & throughput" -> "Batching" to streamline headings. must've changed the generated slug. my bad.

rafel: totally fine. if you can drop the PR I'll review. small ask: include a one-liner in release notes (we track doc fixes).

morgan: creating branch `fix/docs/batching-frag` now. plan: add <!-- anchor: batching --> above the heading and add `id: batching` to frontmatter. also include a short changelog entry under docs/fixes/2025-09-03.md.

morgan: commands I'm running locally:
```bash
git checkout -b fix/docs/batching-frag
# edit docs/runtime/serving.md -> add frontmatter id and HTML anchor
git add docs/runtime/serving.md docs/fixes/2025-09-03.md
git commit -m "docs: restore batching fragment + add changelog note"
git push origin fix/docs/batching-frag
```

morgan: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pull/4380 6 assigned to @anya for a changelog check.

anya: I'll add the tiny release-note blurb and verify wording.

ivy: CR request for @rafael since you found it — quick sanity check would be ideal. low risk.

rafael: looking now. two tiny nits: prefer `id: runtime-batching` to avoid future collisions, and add a test to our docs-smoke script that curls the fragment and expects a 200 with the anchor present.

morgan: good call — updated frontmatter to `id: runtime-batching` and pushed commit a4e9d2. added a simple grep assertion to scripts/docs-smoke.sh.

morgan: updated PR.

anya: LGTM on changelog and note.

morgan: merging after CI passes.

buildbot: PR merged by @morgan into main (commit b9f1c3) 6 deployed to staging. docs smoke target ran: scripts/docs-smoke.sh passed.

raffel: (typo) — thanks y'all! adding a follow-up to our docs checklist to include fragment checks in the weekly smoke job.

anya: nice small win. thanks for the quick turnaround :rocket:

doc-bot: thread closed (auto) — resolved: fragment restored.
